tasks.question: Return each customer region and total completed order amount, only for regions whose total exceeds 150, ordered by region.
schema: CREATE TABLE customers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT)
CREATE TABLE orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount INTEGER, status TEXT)

tasks.question: Return the employee name and salary for the second-highest distinct salary in each department, ordered by department name and employee name.
schema: CREATE TABLE departments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE employees(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, dept_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER)

tasks.question: For each calendar month, count distinct users with at least one login event. Return month YYYY-MM and active_users ordered by month.
schema: CREATE TABLE events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER, event_type TEXT, happened_at TEXT)

tasks.question: For every category, return the two products with highest sales revenue, using product name ascending as the tie-breaker. Return category,name,revenue,rank ordered by category then rank.
schema: CREATE TABLE products(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sales(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER, quantity INTEGER, unit_price INTEGER)

tasks.question: Count open tickets by priority that are past SLA as of 2026-09-24 00:00:00. Return priority and breach_count ordered by priority.
schema: CREATE TABLE tickets(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, priority TEXT, opened_at TEXT, sla_hours INTEGER, status TEXT)

tasks.question: Return user IDs whose subscription churned within 30 days after signup, ordered by user_id.
schema: CREATE TABLE subscriptions(user_id INTEGER, signup_date TEXT, churn_date TEXT)

tasks.question: Return each account and net revenue: successful payments minus completed refunds. Include accounts with successful payments even with no refunds. Order by account.
schema: CREATE TABLE payments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account TEXT, amount INTEGER, status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE refunds(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payment_id INTEGER, amount INTEGER, status TEXT)

tasks.question: Return project names for which every task is done and the project has at least one task, ordered by project name.
schema: CREATE TABLE projects(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE tasks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, project_id INTEGER, status TEXT)
